title: 滲透性反應牆整治~Permeable reactive barriers for remediation
focus: 由地下水路徑、反應時間與介質老化設計反應牆教學模型~Build a reactive-barrier teaching model from groundwater pathways, reaction time and media ageing
summary: 本課以「由地下水路徑、反應時間與介質老化設計反應牆教學模型」為主軸，依序處理污染羽流與牆位概念、反應介質與可用容量、柱試驗動力學、孔隙堵塞與流速變化、牆內外井網驗證。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Build a reactive-barrier teaching model from groundwater pathways, reaction time and media ageing, progressing through Plume and conceptual barrier position, Reactive medium and usable capacity, Column-test kinetics, Pore clogging and velocity change, Inside/outside monitoring network. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 污染羽流與牆位概念~Plume and conceptual barrier position
units.mechanism: 先在剖面定位羽流寬深、地下水流向和未污染旁通區，不能只在地表畫一條線稱完整截流。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。~Locate plume width and depth, groundwater direction and bypass zones in section; a surface line alone does not establish interception. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
units.verify: 針對「污染羽流與牆位概念」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Plume and conceptual barrier position, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「污染羽流與牆位概念」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Plume and conceptual barrier position flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 地下水孔隙流速永遠等於水力傳導係數 K。~Pore-water velocity always equals hydraulic conductivity K.
units.practice: 只將 ne 改成 0.20，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3456 變成 0.432 m/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ne to 0.20, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.3456 to 0.432 m/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 被動穿流與水力匹配~Passive flow and hydraulic matching
units.mechanism: 比較牆前後水頭及天然梯度，辨識污染水是穿牆、繞牆還是從牆底通過。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。~Compare heads across the wall and natural gradient to distinguish through-flow from side or underflow bypass. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.
units.verify: 針對「被動穿流與水力匹配」，測井口標高並校正液位，將多井等水頭線與地層圖共同判讀。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Passive flow and hydraulic matching, Survey reference elevations, correct water levels and interpret multiwell contours with stratigraphy. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「被動穿流與水力匹配」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Different screen depths or measurement times can create a false horizontal gradient. Mark where this error can enter the Passive flow and hydraulic matching flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任意兩口井的液位差都代表同一含水層的水平流向。~Any two well levels define horizontal flow in the same aquifer.
units.practice: 只將 h1 改成 12.7 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.02 變成 0.03 m/m。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only h1 to 12.7 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.02 to 0.03 m/m. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 反應介質與可用容量~Reactive medium and usable capacity
units.mechanism: 用柱試驗比較介質反應、吸附及沉澱作用，保存進出水和介質固相的質量收支。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。~Compare reaction, sorption and precipitation in column tests and retain mass balances for influent, effluent and solids. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：介質質量 m=1000 kg；假設可用容量 a=0.02 kg/kg；污染輸入 L=0.25 kg/d。公式 t=m*a/L，計算得 80 d。適用邊界：固定負荷與已驗證可用容量，不推定真實突破日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Media mass m=1000 kg; assumed usable capacity a=0.02 kg/kg; pollutant loading L=0.25 kg/d. Formula t=m*a/L gives 80 d. Applicability: Constant loading and validated usable capacity; no real breakthrough date is implied.
units.verify: 針對「反應介質與可用容量」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Reactive medium and usable capacity, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「反應介質與可用容量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Reactive medium and usable capacity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 介質總質量相同時，不同水質下的使用壽命必定相同。~Equal media mass guarantees equal life in different water chemistry.
units.practice: 只將 L 改成 0.40 kg/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 50 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only loading L to 0.40 kg/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 50 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 牆厚與接觸時間~Wall thickness and contact time
units.mechanism: 從有效孔隙率而非總體積推估接觸時間，先檢驗是否有優先通道。 反應接觸時間由孔隙水路徑與通量決定；流量增加使可用反應時間減少。~Estimate contact time from effective pore space and first test for preferential paths. Reactive contact time depends on pore path and flux; higher flow reduces time available for reaction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：反應牆厚度 L=1.2 m；有效孔隙率 ne=0.35；Darcy 通量 q=0.07 m/d。公式 t=L*ne/q，計算得 5 d。適用邊界：均勻平面穿流、無繞流與堵塞，厚度不是設計建議。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Barrier thickness L=1.2 m; effective porosity ne=0.35; Darcy flux q=0.07 m/d. Formula t=L*ne/q gives 5 d. Applicability: Uniform planar flow with no bypass or clogging; thickness is not a design recommendation.
units.verify: 針對「牆厚與接觸時間」，以柱試驗求動力學，再用上下游井與示蹤驗證是否穿越反應區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Wall thickness and contact time, Obtain kinetics from column tests, then use wells and tracers to verify passage through the reactive zone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 牆體阻力增大可使污染羽流繞過，單測牆內濃度會漏判。 在「牆厚與接觸時間」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Increasing wall resistance can divert the plume; internal concentrations alone can miss bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Wall thickness and contact time flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 牆內濃度低就證明所有污染地下水都通過並受到處理。~Low in-wall concentration proves all contaminated groundwater passed through and was treated.
units.practice: 只將 q 改成 0.10 m/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變成 4.2 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only q to 0.10 m/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 5 to 4.2 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 柱試驗動力學~Column-test kinetics
units.mechanism: 以教學一階衰減比較不同接觸時間，量測需能區別反應和僅被介質吸附。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。~Use teaching first-order decay to compare contact times with measurements separating reaction from temporary sorption. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
units.verify: 針對「柱試驗動力學」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Column-test kinetics, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「柱試驗動力學」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Column-test kinetics flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 前兩點符合一階衰減就保證所有後續時間也符合。~Agreement with two early points guarantees first-order decay at all later times.
units.practice: 只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 反應序列與中間物~Reaction sequence and intermediates
units.mechanism: 沿流向同測母物及可能中間物；母物被轉化不保證終產物已形成。 串聯反應中間產物的累積是上游生成減下游消耗；只測母物不能判斷完整反應。~Measure parent and potential intermediates along flow; parent conversion does not prove final-product formation. Intermediate accumulation in sequential reactions equals upstream formation minus downstream consumption; parent-only analysis cannot establish completion.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：母物轉化 n=10 mol；假設中間物化學計量 y=1 mol/mol；再降解 d=6 mol。公式 intermediate=n*y-d，計算得 4 mol。適用邊界：抽象單一路徑與已知化學計量，不指定實際污染物的毒性或現場處方。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Parent transformed n=10 mol; assumed intermediate yield y=1 mol/mol; subsequent degradation d=6 mol. Formula intermediate=n*y-d gives 4 mol. Applicability: An abstract single pathway with known stoichiometry; no real-compound toxicity or field prescription is implied.
units.verify: 針對「反應序列與中間物」，以莫耳量核對母物、中間物與終產物，附回收率和未量測支路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Reaction sequence and intermediates, Reconcile parent, intermediates and products on a molar basis, including recovery and unmeasured branches. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 下游反應受限會在母物已下降時累積中間產物。 在「反應序列與中間物」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A downstream bottleneck accumulates intermediates even while the parent declines. Mark where this error can enter the Reaction sequence and intermediates flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 母物移除百分比必然等於完整降解百分比。~Parent-removal percentage always equals complete-degradation percentage.
units.practice: 只將後續降解 d 改成 3 mol，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 7 mol。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only subsequent degradation d to 3 mol, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 7 mol. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 孔隙堵塞與流速變化~Pore clogging and velocity change
units.mechanism: 將礦物沉澱或生物膜造成的有效孔隙變化加入教學模型，觀察流速與接觸時間一起改變。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。~Represent effective-pore changes from precipitation or biofilm and observe coupled velocity and residence changes. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
units.verify: 針對「孔隙堵塞與流速變化」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Pore clogging and velocity change, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「孔隙堵塞與流速變化」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Pore clogging and velocity change flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 地下水孔隙流速永遠等於水力傳導係數 K。~Pore-water velocity always equals hydraulic conductivity K.
units.practice: 只將 ne 改成 0.20，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3456 變成 0.432 m/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ne to 0.20, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.3456 to 0.432 m/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 介質耗盡與負荷波動~Media exhaustion and loading variation
units.mechanism: 用季節流量與濃度重新估算污染通量，分開化學容量耗盡和表面鈍化。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。~Re-estimate load from seasonal flow and concentration and distinguish capacity exhaustion from surface passivation. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：介質質量 m=1000 kg；假設可用容量 a=0.02 kg/kg；污染輸入 L=0.25 kg/d。公式 t=m*a/L，計算得 80 d。適用邊界：固定負荷與已驗證可用容量，不推定真實突破日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Media mass m=1000 kg; assumed usable capacity a=0.02 kg/kg; pollutant loading L=0.25 kg/d. Formula t=m*a/L gives 80 d. Applicability: Constant loading and validated usable capacity; no real breakthrough date is implied.
units.verify: 針對「介質耗盡與負荷波動」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Media exhaustion and loading variation, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「介質耗盡與負荷波動」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Media exhaustion and loading variation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 介質總質量相同時，不同水質下的使用壽命必定相同。~Equal media mass guarantees equal life in different water chemistry.
units.practice: 只將 L 改成 0.40 kg/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 50 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only loading L to 0.40 kg/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 50 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 牆內外井網驗證~Inside/outside monitoring network
units.mechanism: 在上游、牆內、下游和兩側建立教學採樣格，避免只用牆內低濃度證明成功。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。~Build sampling cells upstream, within, downstream and beside the barrier rather than inferring success from low internal concentrations. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
units.verify: 針對「牆內外井網驗證」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Inside/outside monitoring network, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「牆內外井網驗證」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Inside/outside monitoring network flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 樣本平均值低就代表每個未採樣位置也都低。~A low sample mean proves every unsampled location is also low.
units.practice: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 壽命、維護與證據交接~Life, maintenance and evidence handoff
units.mechanism: 整理可用容量、實際流路及季節不確定度，向下一位玩家交付需要補測的參數。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Handoff usable capacity, actual pathways and seasonal uncertainty with a list of parameters needing further measurement. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「壽命、維護與證據交接」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Life, maintenance and evidence handoff, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「壽命、維護與證據交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Life, maintenance and evidence handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
